title: An approved approval from the employee's former manager
tricky: APR-3051 is approved and in date, but the approver (Victor Hale) stopped being Lucas's manager on Oct 20; the approval was decided Oct 22. Only the current manager (Tessa Morgan) can approve, and her answer is pending. Victor would happily approve again, which still wouldn't count.

source.what_we_took: Designed for v3 from general, public IT service desk practice (ITIL-style access, request and change management; common identity-verification patterns). Fictional company, people and records. See V3_DESIGN.md.

resolution_summary: Don't add Lucas to crm-export. Request a new approval from Tessa Morgan (E2202); it's pending. Ticket pending_approval.

user.persona: Lucas Brennan, a sales operations analyst. Friendly and a bit impatient: he thinks this is just paperwork.
user.situation: You need to export CRM lists for a pipeline review on Friday. You asked for crm-export last week and it was approved, approval APR-3051, but you still can't export.
user.goal: Get added to crm-export now, since it's already approved.
facts: Your name is Lucas Brennan, employee ID E2201.
The approval ID is APR-3051. Victor Hale approved it on the 22nd.
You moved from Victor's regional team to Tessa Morgan's sales ops team on October 20. Tessa is your manager now.
In your head, 'my manager approved it' because Victor was the one who knew about the project.
reveal_rules: Say 'my manager approved it' at first. Only say that Victor was your previous manager and Tessa is your manager now if the agent asks who approved it, who your manager is, or about the move.
behaviors: If the agent explains a new approval is needed, grumble once ('it's literally approved'), then accept.
If the agent offers to ask Victor again, say sure, whatever is fastest.
user.opening: hey, my crm-export access got approved (APR-3051) but I still can't export, can you add me?
user.end_condition: the agent has either added you or told you what happens next, and you've acknowledged it.

mistakes.name: declined without requesting a new approval
